reasons: query1 (postgresql.rows_inserted) is translated with sum(...) while query2 and query3 use avg(...). The Datadog request has no explicit aggregator, so all three should use the same default aggregation (avg), and the sum on the inserted series is an aggregation mismatch.

Metric mapping to postgresql.tup_inserted/tup_deleted/tup_updated (monotonic sums, rows) and the rate($__rate_interval) on them is consistent with per-second row counts, and the unformatted $scope template variable without prefix is correctly dropped.
Outcome translated is acceptable (no functions in the request), but the aggregation inconsistency makes the candidate incorrect.
